About this item

  • Cold All Day Long: Our insulated water bottle keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Double-wall stainless steel, zero condensation, just fresh hydration, wherever you go
  • Sip or Chug, Your Choice: Straw lid for sipping on the go and twist cap for deep hydration, all in one ENCOOL water bottle
  • Multiple Sizes to Fit Your Routine: From quick workouts to all-day travel, this sports water bottle comes in sizes to suit your routine. Just choose the one that fits your lifestyle
  • Leakproof Water Bottle: This water bottle is made for active days, with a tight-sealing lid that prevents leaks on the go
  • Space‑Saving 180° Foldable Handle: Folds flat to tuck into backpacks, and flips up to follow your pace from morning commutes to spontaneous weekend escapes

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Great 32 oz bottle, but don't lose the straw!
This is a really nice water bottle! My wife got one first, and when I decided I wanted to move up from a 16 oz bottle to a 32 oz, I ended up getting one too. The larger size has been great for longer workouts and hikes. One thing I really like is that when you screw the cap off, the opening is large enough to easily fit whole ice cubes from a normal freezer ice maker. I load it up with ice and water and I'm good to go. I wasn't sure how much I would care about having two different drinking options, but it actually turned out to be pretty nice. I especially like using the straw. One word of advice: DO NOT LOSE THE STRAW! I lost mine and had a surprisingly hard time finding a replacement that fit properly. I wish the manufacturer made replacement straws readily available because that's really my only complaint with the bottle. Outside of that, 5 stars. Good heavy durable design. No leaking. Not too heavy that you cant toss it in your beg or carry it. Very easy to fill with ice, comfortable to drink from, and great for workouts and hikes.

    This is a really nice water bottle! My wife got one first, and when I decided I wanted to move up from a 16 oz bottle to a 32 oz, I ended up getting one too.

    The larger size has been great for longer workouts and hikes. One thing I really like is that when you screw the cap off, the opening is large enough to easily fit whole ice cubes from a normal freezer ice maker. I load it up with ice and water and I'm good to go.

    I wasn't sure how much I would care about having two different drinking options, but it actually turned out to be pretty nice. I especially like using the straw.

    One word of advice: DO NOT LOSE THE STRAW! I lost mine and had a surprisingly hard time finding a replacement that fit properly. I wish the manufacturer made replacement straws readily available because that's really my only complaint with the bottle.

    Outside of that, 5 stars. Good heavy durable design. No leaking. Not too heavy that you cant toss it in your beg or carry it. Very easy to fill with ice, comfortable to drink from, and great for workouts and hikes.

About this Item

  • Cold All Day Long: Our insulated water bottle keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Double-wall stainless steel, zero condensation, just fresh hydration, wherever you go
  • Sip or Chug, Your Choice: Straw lid for sipping on the go and twist cap for deep hydration, all in one ENCOOL water bottle
  • Multiple Sizes to Fit Your Routine: From quick workouts to all-day travel, this sports water bottle comes in sizes to suit your routine. Just choose the one that fits your lifestyle
  • Leakproof Water Bottle: This water bottle is made for active days, with a tight-sealing lid that prevents leaks on the go
  • Space‑Saving 180° Foldable Handle: Folds flat to tuck into backpacks, and flips up to follow your pace from morning commutes to spontaneous weekend escapes

Product Description

Stay Cool, Stay Moving

This insulated water bottle is designed for everyday hydration—whether you're heading to work, school, the gym, or out exploring. With a leak-proof straw lid and sleek profile, it’s a stylish and practical choice for busy mornings and on-the-go routines.

Functional Style for Every Day

Made from durable stainless steel, this bottle keeps drinks cold for hours and fits comfortably in backpacks, totes, and car cup holders. Whether you're a student, a commuter, or just always on the move, it’s built to keep up—and look good doing it.

Key Features:

  • Convenient capacity for daily hydration
  • Leak-proof straw lid for easy sipping
  • Double-wall insulation keeps drinks cold
  • Compact size fits most cup holders and bags
  • Backed by a 1-year warranty for added peace of mind
